intent: Dark, monochrome daily health summary: three activity rings that draw in, lap past 100% into a deeper shade and isolate on tap, over graphite metric cards and a gliding week selector, with the whole frame choreographed on first view.

layout.header: uppercase date line over a 34pt 'Summary'; 42pt avatar: 34pt graphite disc with initials inside a 1.6pt white-gradient ring that draws in
layout.week: graphite surface (radius 22), 7 columns (letter + 30pt mini rings), gliding pill, future days disabled
layout.rings: 264pt box, stroke 22, gap 3, padding 6; centre readout: micro label (TODAY or weekday), 34pt value + muted suffix, sub line
layout.legend: 3 columns: ring-colour swatch, grey label, 19pt white value with muted goal; doubles as ring buttons
layout.cards: Steps (flex 1.18, sparkline) + Heart (flex 1, ECG trace); Sleep full width with stacked stage bar and 4-column key; labels and icons in 56% white

color.approach: monochrome first: one true-neutral family; colour only for the rings (data), a focused ring's centre label, and one accent; focus halo and tip shadows are neutral

charts.sparkline: white line 30%→95% left to right over a 12%→0 white fill
charts.sleep: white ramp: Deep 94%, Core 60%, REM 36%, Awake 16%

color.statusBar: scrim at rest; BlurView 50 dark + hairline fades in on scroll

motion.cues: one CUE table in ms from mount, reading order: date 0, title 50, week 100 (mini rings 190 + 40/day), rings 150 (draw from 220), legend 240/290/340, steps 300, heart 350, sleep 400; figures +120, charts +180; avatar pop 480, avatar ring 560
motion.blockReveal: opacity 0→1, 12pt rise, BlurView veil intensity 40→0, 560ms ease-out (0.22,1,0.36,1); veil unmounts and the transform drops once landed
motion.figures: count up from 0 (760ms ease-out), tabular, fade + 5pt lift + 4px filter blur clearing (no filter on iOS); later changes count from the previous value (620ms) with a light settle
motion.ringsDrawIn: stagger 70ms, 720ms + 160ms per lap, ease-out; dash offset on an SVG mask
motion.charts: sparkline strokes in left to right (840ms) then fill and accent dot; ECG trace strokes in (640ms) then the comet starts; sleep segments grow from the left 70ms apart
motion.avatar: disc pops 0.8→1 with one small overshoot (bezier 0.34,1.45,0.64,1), then the ring draws along its path
motion.overshoot: second lap in a deeper gradient; tip dot colour interpolated from progress, with a neutral forward shadow onto lap one (no coloured glow)
motion.daySwitch: lighter replay: pill spring 500/40; rings ease from current to new values (820ms, 0.65,0,0.35,1, stagger 60ms); figures recount; old sparkline and ECG fade out (110ms), new ones draw in 60ms later; sleep segments re-flex; date and bed times crossfade with 5pt rise; containers stay
motion.isolate: others dim to 10% and scale 0.985 (spring 300/34), a neutral white halo (7% peak) fades in, label crossfades, value counts to %
motion.ambient: accent comet travels the ECG trace at the resting rate
motion.press: spring to 0.90–0.97, release with a single small overshoot
motion.reducedMotion: every entrance a 150ms fade (no rise, no veil); figures and rings set instantly; comet off; crossfades instant
platformNotes: start each animation a frame after mount
fade a BlurView's own opacity, never an ancestor's

responsive.width: 360–430pt; rings fixed at 264pt, centred; cards flex; week columns divide the bar width

accessibility: week days are tabs with selected and disabled state
ring area is a button whose label reads all three values; legend columns are buttons with selected state
sleep bar has a spoken summary of every stage

content.today: Friday, 9 October: Move 612/540 kcal (113%), Exercise 38/30 min, Stand 9/12 hr; 8,412 steps, 6.1 km; resting 59 bpm (52–148); slept 6h 52m (in bed 23:27–06:41)
content.week: Mon 5 – Sun 11 October; Saturday and Sunday are future and disabled

avoid: tinted page or cards, coloured card icons, a hue per sleep stage, coloured background glows
one linear gradient on a full circle (it seams)
rings that redraw from zero on every day switch
any block that pops in unanimated
code: small named pieces: useCue, Reveal + Veil, useCount + CountUp, Swap, Squish, Surface, Avatar, WeekSelector, RingStage, Legend, StepsCard, HeartCard, SleepCard
tokens in COLOR, MOTION and CUE
